convert_to_pngs: convert PDF files from the input folder to PNG images using DoclingParseV4 backend
quantize_model: quantize an OpenVINO model using NNCF with configurable precision and ignored scopes
run_create_eval: create a prediction dataset for layout evaluation using a given OpenVINO model
run_evaluate: evaluate layout modality predictions and save results as JSON
validation_function: validate a quantized OpenVINO model by running evaluation and returning mean mAP score
